editorialNotes: Object discoveries avoid grammatical-gender assumptions for inserted wallet item names and use locked museum, item and character terminology.
TV channels follow the locked glossary; broadcasts consistently address the audience with polite plural Bulgarian except the game's direct recipe-state messages.
Forecast fragments, dialogue caret, trailing spaces, placeholders, channel number and null literal remain exact.

corrections: Aligned discovery and television system messages with the established polite-plural Bulgarian register.
Removed a repeated verb from the Oracle introduction and refined the mild-luck forecast and singular wallpaper label.
